name: Undeformed Space Ray Start via Deformed Hull Intersection
definition: A method to find the ray start point x̂₀ = D⁻¹(p) in undeformed space without computing the inverse D⁻¹ directly, by intersecting the deformed view ray with a deformed explicit hull mesh that contains the surface.
summary: Undeformed Space Ray Start via Deformed Hull Intersection approximates the inverse deformation map by intersecting view rays with a deformed hull mesh, avoiding direct inversion.
